newsitem.title: UK: Inntrepreneur welcomes UK DTI ruling.
newsitem.headline: Inntrepreneur welcomes UK DTI ruling.

text.p: Inntrepreneur said on Wednesday it welcomed the decision by Britain's Department of Trade and Industry to release the pub estate from certain restrictions.

Inntrepreneur, owned jointly by Grand Metropolitan Plc and Foster's Brewing Group Ltd said that as a result of the DTI's recommendation to change constraints on its tied pubs it would have the same opportunities to compete as its rivals.
"Inntrepreneur has now been given the opportunity to operate on the same playing field as other independent pub companies," said Mike Foster, chief executive of Inntrepeneur.
The government department said earlier that Inntrepeneur should no longer require its pub tenants to take beer exclusively from Scottish & Newcastle which owns the Courage brands.

S&N currently supplies beer to all of Inntrepreneur's estate of pubs which expires in March 1998. The new undertaking requires Inntrepreneur to offer more choice of beers to its tenants after March 1998.
Inntrepreneur plans to introduce discounts and savings on a range of bbers and a variety of other products and services.
